name: Sales coordinator
summary: Answers enquiries fast, sends clear packages and proposals and follows up until the date is booked. Works for venues, wedding suppliers, studios, travel agents and estate agents.

changelog.note: First release: role knowledge with 27 checked sources (UK and US total-price rules, EU and UK cancellation rights, package travel and ATOL, UK property listing and US fair housing rules, CRM duplicates and pipelines, quotes, e-signatures, EDI and Incoterms), four skills, five prompts, three workflows, training interview and test briefs.
